<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"> <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
<groupId>es.iesquevedo</groupId> <artifactId>InazumaGo</artifactId> <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
<properties> <maven.compiler.source>21</maven.compiler.source> <maven.compiler.target>21</maven.compiler.target> <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding> </properties>
<dependencies> <!-- JavaFX para UI --> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-controls</artifactId> <version>21</version> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-fxml</artifactId> <version>21</version> </dependency>
<!-- Test dependencies --> <dependency> <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId> <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId> <version>5.10.0</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>com.github.tomakehurst</groupId> <artifactId>wiremock-jre8</artifactId> <version>2.35.0</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>com.google.firebase</groupId> <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId> <version>9.8.0</version> </dependency>
<!-- Mockito dependancies --> <dependency> <groupId>org.mockito</groupId> <artifactId>mockito-core</artifactId> <version>5.5.0</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.mockito</groupId> <artifactId>mockito-junit-jupiter</artifactId> <version>5.5.0</version> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> </dependencies>
<build> <plugins> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <version>3.1.2</version> <configuration> <useModulePath>false</useModulePath> <excludes> <exclude>**/MainTest.java</exclude> </excludes> </configuration> </plugin> <plugin> <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId> <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>0.8.12</version> <executions> <execution> <id>prepare-agent</id> <goals> <goal>prepare-agent</goal> </goals> </execution> <execution> <id>report</id> <phase>test</phase> <goals> <goal>report</goal> </goals> </execution> </executions> </plugin> </plugins> </build> </project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <?import javafx.geometry.Insets?> <?import javafx.scene.control.Button?> <?import javafx.scene.control.Label?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.HBox?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.VBox?> <?import javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas?>
<BorderPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml" fx:controller="es.iesquevedo.controller.GameController" prefWidth="900" prefHeight="800">
<!-- TOP: Información de jugadores y tiempo --> <top> <VBox spacing="10" style="-fx-border-color: #CCCCCC; -fx-border-width: 0 0 2 0;"> <padding> <Insets top="10" bottom="10" left="15" right="15"/> </padding>
<!-- Nombres de jugadores y marcador --> <HBox spacing="20" alignment="CENTER"> <!-- Jugador 1 (Negro) --> <VBox spacing="5" style="-fx-border-color: #333333; -fx-border-width: 2; -fx-padding: 10;"> <Label fx:id="player1NameLabel" text="Jugador 1 (Negro)" style="-fx-font-size: 14; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/> <Label fx:id="player1ScoreLabel" text="Puntos: 0" style="-fx-font-size: 12;"/> <Label fx:id="player1TimeLabel" text="Tiempo: 00:00" style="-fx-font-size: 11; -fx-text-fill: #666666;"/> </VBox>
<!-- VS --> <Label text="VS" style="-fx-font-size: 16; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/>
<!-- Jugador 2 (Blanco) --> <VBox spacing="5" style="-fx-border-color: #FFFFFF; -fx-border-width: 2; -fx-padding: 10; -fx-background-color: #F5F5F5;"> <Label fx:id="player2NameLabel" text="Jugador 2 (Blanco)" style="-fx-font-size: 14; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/> <Label fx:id="player2ScoreLabel" text="Puntos: 0" style="-fx-font-size: 12;"/> <Label fx:id="player2TimeLabel" text="Tiempo: 00:00" style="-fx-font-size: 11; -fx-text-fill: #666666;"/> </VBox> </HBox>
<!-- Turno actual --> <Label fx:id="currentTurnLabel" text="Turno: Jugador 1" style="-fx-font-size: 12; -fx-text-alignment: center;" alignment="CENTER"/> </VBox> </top>
<!-- CENTER: Tablero --> <center> <VBox spacing="10" alignment="CENTER" style="-fx-background-color: #F0F0F0;"> <padding> <Insets top="15" bottom="15" left="15" right="15"/> </padding>
<!-- Canvas para el tablero --> <Canvas fx:id="boardCanvas" width="500" height="500" style="-fx-border-color: #000000; -fx-border-width: 1;"/> </VBox> </center>
<!-- BOTTOM: Controles --> <bottom> <VBox spacing="10" style="-fx-border-color: #CCCCCC; -fx-border-width: 2 0 0 0;"> <padding> <Insets top="10" bottom="10" left="15" right="15"/> </padding>
<HBox spacing="10" alignment="CENTER"> <Button text="Pasar turno" onAction="#onPassTurn" style="-fx-padding: 8px 20px; -fx-font-size: 12;"/> <Button text="Deshacer" onAction="#onUndo" style="-fx-padding: 8px 20px; -fx-font-size: 12;"/> <Button text="Rendirse" onAction="#onSurrender" style="-fx-padding: 8px 20px; -fx-font-size: 12; -fx-text-fill: red;"/> <Button text="Volver al menú" onAction="#onBackToMenu" style="-fx-padding: 8px 20px; -fx-font-size: 12;"/> </HBox>
<Label fx:id="statusLabel" text="" style="-fx-font-size: 11; -fx-text-fill: #666666;" wrapText="true" alignment="CENTER"/> </VBox> </bottom> </BorderPane>
